name: Kustomer
oneLiner: AI-native customer service platform and CRM that organizes every conversation into one customer timeline, with AI Agents for customers, reps and leaders. Independent again after Meta divested it in 2023.
bestFor: Consumer brands with high contact volumes and order-related questions that want AI and agents working from the full customer history.

updates.text: Launched Kustomer AI, a standalone enterprise AI platform that sits on top of existing helpdesks, starting with Zendesk.
Added AI Assistants, including a generally available automation assistant and an observability assistant in early access.
Raised a $30M Series B led by Norwest to build out its AI-native platform.

features: Unified customer timeline with orders and past conversations
Email, chat, voice, SMS, WhatsApp and social messaging in one workspace
Concierge (formerly AI for Customers): customer-facing AI agent that resolves requests across channels using customer context
Envoy (AI Agents for Reps): surfaces order history, open issues and sentiment, and suggests replies and next steps
Architect: builds, deploys, analyzes and improves AI agents and workflows
Kustomer Voice for phone support (talk, SMS and transcription)
Workflow builder and AI-based routing and prioritization
Data connections to commerce and order systems
Analytics and AI observability for leaders

pricing.text: No published plan prices: the current Enterprise and Ultimate plans both show 'Talk to Sales'. Add-ons on the pricing details page (last updated October 12, 2026): Concierge $0.75 per engaged conversation; Envoy $50 per user / month; Kustomer Voice starting at $0.02 / minute; HIPAA Compliance $25 per user / month; WhatsApp usage fees; some configurations need a statement of work and an implementation fee.

notes: Homepage, pricing and comprehensive pricing pages fetched 2026-11; earlier facts from search results. A third-party tracker reported a Concierge/Envoy price change in late October 2026; the vendor page (updated October 12, 2026) is used. Vendor-reported customer metrics on the homepage are not used. G2 count from a search snippet of the G2 product page (July 2026).
pros: One timeline per customer with orders and past conversations, shared by agents and AI
Kustomer AI can run on top of an existing Zendesk helpdesk
AI for customers (Concierge), reps (Envoy) and builders (Architect) in one platform
Rated 4.4/5 on G2 from 558 reviews (the homepage shows 4.4 from 500+ reviews)
Customers include sweetgreen, Everlane and HexClad

cons.text: No published plan prices: Enterprise and Ultimate both show 'Talk to Sales'
AI is an add-on: Concierge costs $0.75 per engaged conversation and Envoy $50 per user per month
Some configurations need a statement of work and an implementation fee
Built for consumer brands with high contact volumes, so a single restaurant or small group may not need its depth

plans.billing: quoted by sales; add-ons per user per month or per use
plans.note: Current plans Enterprise and Ultimate, both 'Talk to Sales'; Professional, Business and the usage-based AI plans are legacy.
